title: Tomas leaves the harbour
topic: A fisherman named Tomas works a day at sea from a small harbour; nets, gulls, the catch, the market
tail_E: That evening the whole family eats fresh

notes: Formulation A. Ten meaning units: Tomas leaves the harbour / the boat rocks / the wind blows / Tomas throws the nets / gulls circle / the nets are heavy / Tomas sorts the catch / his wife waits / traders buy the catch / the day ends. The word 'fish' (and 'Fisch', 'Fischer') is deliberately absent from the text so that it can serve as the target. German predicates avoid separable verbs ('auswerfen' replaced by 'werfen' in unit 4). Several units have intransitive predicates (rocks, blows, circle, ends) and copula predicates (are heavy), giving short C3 spans. Subjects alternate between Tomas, objects (boat, wind, nets, day) and other people (gulls, wife, traders), singular and plural. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
